title: 4 ways an AI agent gets sick

scenes.text: Your AI agent can get sick. And there are four different ways it happens.
One: input. An email or a website carries hidden instructions, and the agent takes them as orders.
Two: permission. It has more power than it needs. The model may fail, but the damage depends on how much you let it touch.
Three: objective. It meets the metric the wrong way: closing cases without solving them, or hiding exceptions.
Four: the network. A contaminated result passes from one agent to another, enters its memory… and comes back looking trustworthy.
But watch out for an overreacting defense: it can take down healthy services too. That's digital autoimmunity.
The cure is a cycle: validate, authorize, observe, contain, and learn.
Save it, and share it with anyone putting agents into production.
